title: Finite-strip cone diagonal three-term comparison
statement: Let C be an abelian category and K an integer-indexed commuting double cochain complex with total [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let r be a natural number such that the complex K.X i is zero for i<0 or r<=i. Let A be an integer cochain complex, a_n:A.X n→K^(0,n), and b:A→Tot(K) a chain map with b_n equal to a_n followed by the (0,n) total inclusion. For each integer p supply a chain map f_p from the single complex A.X p in degree zero to the horizontal row K.flip.X p, with component zero equal to a_p via the canonical single-object identification. Let F be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of Cone(b) [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Assume its step in degree m is the join of the source inclusion image when p<=m+1 and the images of the target diagonal inclusions K^(i,m-i) for 0<=i<r and p<=m-i. Then for every p,n the short complex in degrees n-1,n,n+1 of gr_F^p Cone(b) is isomorphic to the short complex in degrees n-p-1,n-p,n-p+1 of Cone(f_p).

source.place: Lemma 12.25.4, second-variable variant; explicit cone refinement of lem-sc-finite-strip-cone-filtration, step 3

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed graded maps. The degreewise invertibility lemma turns their three relevant components into isomorphisms; the differential lemma provides the two commuting squares. Apply ShortComplex.isoMk in the row-to-graded direction and take its inverse, simplifying the integer degree expressions.

proof_origin: G3 stage-3 Lean proof from explicit diagonal maps, invertibility and commutation as independent lower obligations.

theorem finite_strip_cone_filtration_graded_point
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [K.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)] (r : ℕ)
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ (r : ℤ) ≤ i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (A : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (a : ∀ n : ℤ, A.X n ⟶ (K.X 0).X n)
    (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ n : ℤ, b.f n =
      a n ≫ K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (Int.zero_add n))
    (f : ∀ p : ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj (A.X p) ⟶ K.flip.X p)
    (hf : ∀ p : ℤ, (f p).f 0 = (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 (A.X p)).hom ≫ a p)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone b))
    (hsteps : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
      (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl b).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
      (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (r : ℤ)).sup (fun i ↦
        if p ≤ n - i then imageSubobject
          (K.ιTotalOrZero (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i (n - i) n ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr b).f n) else ⊥))
    (p n : ℤ) : Nonempty ((F.gradedPiece p).sc n ≅
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone (f p)).sc (n - p))
